sentences.en: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell,
sentences.zh: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士
sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 是第一个以每小时300多英里的速度驾车的人。

sentences.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
sentences.zh: 1935年9月，他在犹他州的博纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。

sentences.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
sentences.zh: 他驾驶的“蓝鸟”牌汽车是专门为他制造的。

sentences.en: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2, 500-horsepower engine.
sentences.zh: 车长30多英尺，装有一台2,500马力的发动机。

sentences.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour,
sentences.zh: 虽然坎贝尔达到了每小时304英里的速度，

sentences.en: he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
sentences.zh: 但他很难控制汽车，因为在第一次跑时一个轮胎爆了。

chunks.x: because a tyre burst during the first run

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔失望地得知他的平均时速是299英里。

sentences.en: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
sentences.zh: 然而几天后，他被告知出了一个差错。

chunks.x: that a mistake had been made

sentences.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，赛车手的时速已超过600英里。

sentences.en: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，马尔科姆的儿子唐纳德步父亲的后尘，也创造了一项世界纪录。

chunks.x: Following in his father 's footsteps many years later

sentences.en: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
sentences.zh: 和父亲一样，他驾驶的也是一辆叫“蓝鸟”的汽车。
